name: Achenkirch
kurzbeschreibung: Relaxation spot on the northern shore of the Achensee, featuring the Christlum ski area and lakeside access.
beschreibung:
Achenkirch lies at 916 m above sea level on the northern west shore of Achensee, in the district of Schwaz, and with its roughly 2,200 inhabitants it is the most sprawling village on the "Tiroler Meer". The village stretches for several kilometres along the lake and is the sunniest spot on Achensee – here the clouds shed their rain on the Karwendel before they reach the shore.

🌊 The Christlum ski area right in the village is compact and family-friendly: 27 kilometres of pistes, manageable lift facilities and its own children's ski school make it attractive for beginners and families. In summer, the same area turns into a hiking area with views of Achensee and the Karwendel. The lake itself is the main attraction – Achenkirch has several free bathing spots, a large marina and offers pedal boat, sailing and SUP rentals. Diving in Achensee is known beyond the region for its excellent visibility. Insider tip: the bay near Scholastika, about three kilometres to the south, is much quieter than the main beach.

In culinary terms, Achenkirch is strongly shaped by fishing – Saiblinge and Renken from Achensee are on almost every menu. The lakeside road runs through the village without steep inclines, which also makes it interesting for cyclists and holidaymakers with limited mobility. Those seeking peace and quiet will find it especially in the evening hours, when the day-trippers from the south have departed.
